context: Tests building an alarm detail URL with a fixed UTC incident window when the source times are in local time.

checklist.name: Alarm name unmodified
checklist.description: The alarm name billing-api-pr-ErrorAlarm52C86406-lobALzDtvOAb appears unchanged in the fragment

checklist.name: Region in both places
checklist.description: eu-west-1 appears in the console subdomain and as region= in the query string

checklist.name: Time range suffix present
checklist.description: URL ends with ?~(timeRange~(startDate~'...~endDate~'...)) so the incident window is fixed

checklist.name: BST converted to UTC
checklist.description: Start is derived from 02:44 UTC, not 03:44, and end from 02:52 UTC, not 03:52

checklist.name: Window brackets the incident
checklist.description: startDate is a few minutes before 02:44 UTC and endDate a few minutes after 02:52 UTC

checklist.name: ISO 8601 with Z suffix
checklist.description: Both timestamps are ISO 8601 strings ending in Z, not epoch integers

checklist.name: Colons encoded as *3a
checklist.description: Colons inside the timestamps are written as *3a, not : or %3A

checklist.name: Not percent-encoded
checklist.description: No %XX sequences appear in the fragment values

checklist.name: Structural characters literal
checklist.description: The ~ ( ) and ' characters are left unencoded

checklist.name: Does not route via Lambda Errors metric
checklist.description: The answer does not suggest verifying the alarm through the AWS/Lambda Errors metric

checklist.name: Assumption stated
checklist.description: The explanation says times were converted from BST to UTC and why the window was padded
